## File: facebookresearch_flowdec/flowdec/eval/metrics.py

Prompts

```
['run get_metrics_df to compute audio quality metrics across a batch of estimated and reference audio files', 'run get_metrics_df_parallel to compute audio quality metrics in parallel using multiprocessing across audio file triples', 'create an InitializeMetrics instance to configure and initialize a list of audio quality metrics for evaluation', 'review the SISXR metric class to understand how SI-SDR, SI-SIR, and SI-SAR are computed from audio signals', 'test the ViSQOL metric class to measure audio quality MOS scores using subprocess or C bindings backends']
```

Usage

```
{'run_get_metrics_df': 'run get_metrics_df to compute audio quality metrics across a batch of estimated and reference audio files', 'run_get_metrics_df_parallel': 'run get_metrics_df_parallel to compute audio quality metrics in parallel using multiprocessing across audio file triples', 'create_InitializeMetrics': 'create an InitializeMetrics instance to configure and initialize a list of audio quality metrics for evaluation', 'review_SISXR': 'review the SISXR metric class to understand how SI-SDR, SI-SIR, and SI-SAR are computed from audio signals', 'test_ViSQOL': 'test the ViSQOL metric class to measure audio quality MOS scores using subprocess or C bindings backends'}
```
